record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, preserve newest-128 truncation and cumulative positions; replace fixed recency pooling with a jointly learned scalar gate g_t=sigmoid(w^T h_t+b), initialized to 0.25, giving (1-g_t)*h_t+g_t*pool_t with decay 4. Add a jointly learned input projection of log1p(number of observed prefix interactions), capped at 128 and computed causally before truncation; pass the supplied full-history length consistently at inference. Activity context and adaptive pooling may let one HSTU distinguish sparse from established interests. Preserve frequency scaling, loss, optimizer and backbone settings; save one checkpoint/category and update the predictor writer.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four categories, retain newest-128 histories, cumulative positions and decay-4 causal pooling, while learning a state-dependent pooling gate initialized to 0.25. The generated predictor imports the updated architecture and loads its gate from the single category checkpoint.

Add a jointly learned projection of log1p causal observed-prefix counts capped at 128, preserving the existing frequency feature. Carry full observed-history lengths through sampling, validation and generated prediction so truncation never resets activity counts or exposes future interactions.
